name: AUS legacy activity filters — validate in owner zone before activation

rules.expression: http.host eq "www.argentinauniversosur.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/actividades" and http.request.uri.args["provincia"][0] eq "catarmaca"

http.host eq "www.argentinauniversosur.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/actividades" and http.request.uri.args["provincia"][0] in {"buenos_aires" "caba" "catamarca" "jujuy" "la_rioja" "salta" "santiago_del_estero" "tucuman" "chaco" "corrientes" "entre_rios" "formosa" "misiones" "santa_fe" "cordoba" "mendoza" "san_juan" "san_luis" "chubut" "la_pampa" "neuquen" "rio_negro" "santa_cruz" "tierra_del_fuego"}

http.host eq "www.argentinauniversosur.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/actividades" and http.request.uri.args["provincia"][0] ne "" and not http.request.uri.args["provincia"][0] in {"buenos_aires" "caba" "catamarca" "jujuy" "la_rioja" "salta" "santiago_del_estero" "tucuman" "chaco" "corrientes" "entre_rios" "formosa" "misiones" "santa_fe" "cordoba" "mendoza" "san_juan" "san_luis" "chubut" "la_pampa" "neuquen" "rio_negro" "santa_cruz" "tierra_del_fuego"} and http.request.uri.args["provincia"][0] ne "catarmaca"
